prompts.question: Does the company appear in an ABEI licensing registry (online social network, general news website, or G1-G4 game licence) or in a public penalty notice on abei.gov.vn?
prompts.why_it_matters: Holding the right media or game licence, and avoiding published penalties, shows the business is legally allowed to operate online in Vietnam.

source.name: Authority of Broadcasting and Electronic Information (Cục Phát thanh, Truyền hình và Thông tin Điện tử - ABEI)

prompts.how_to_query: Open ABEI's licence lookup on abei.gov.vn and search the licence registries and penalty notices by the company's full Vietnamese name.
prompts.found_when: The company's name appears in a licence registry entry or in a public penalty notice.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search on the exact company name returns no licence entry and no penalty notice.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The lookup is unavailable, or the abbreviated name matches many unrelated licensed companies.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the AmCham Vietnam member directory on amchamvietnam.com?
prompts.why_it_matters: Chamber membership signals a US-linked or international business that has passed a peer vetting step and can be reached through the chamber.

source.name: American Chamber of Commerce in Vietnam (AmCham Vietnam)

prompts.how_to_query: Open the AmCham Vietnam members page and search the directory for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears as an AmCham Vietnam member with a directory listing.
prompts.not_found_when: The directory search returns no member record for that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The members directory is behind a login, unreadable, or the name is too generic to single out.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in the AusCham Vietnam corporate membership directory on auschamvn.org?
prompts.why_it_matters: Membership shows an Australian or international business affiliation and a verifiable chamber contact route.

source.name: Australian Chamber of Commerce in Vietnam (AusCham Vietnam)

prompts.how_to_query: Open the corporate membership directory page on auschamvn.org and scan the list for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company is present in the corporate member list.
prompts.not_found_when: The full member list contains no entry matching the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory page fails to load or the list is paginated beyond readable access.

prompts.question: Has Báo Đấu Thầu reported on the company in connection with bidding, procurement disputes, or contractor penalties?
prompts.why_it_matters: Coverage in the public bidding press can reveal bid-rigging allegations, sanctions, or project disputes that other sources miss.

source.name: Báo Đấu Thầu (Public Bidding Newspaper)

prompts.how_to_query: Use the site's search box on baodauthau.vn and enter the company's full Vietnamese name.
prompts.found_when: Articles naming the company appear in the search results.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no article naming the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search is blocked or the name is too generic to attribute articles to this company.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the BritCham Vietnam membership directory on britchamvn.com?
prompts.why_it_matters: A BritCham listing confirms a British or international business affiliation and a named chamber contact.

source.name: British Chamber of Commerce Vietnam (BritCham Vietnam)

prompts.how_to_query: Open the BritCham membership directory and browse or scan the member entries for the company name.
prompts.found_when: A member profile page or member list entry names the company.
prompts.not_found_when: No member entry matches the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory is down or member entries are only reachable by an unknown slug.

prompts.question: Does the company have an enterprise profile on CafeF whose leadership, ownership, and reported financials match what the company claims?
prompts.why_it_matters: Independent financial data exposes gaps between what a company says about its size and leadership and what the market records.

source.name: CafeF Enterprise & Equity Database

prompts.how_to_query: Use the CafeF company search and enter the company's Vietnamese name or ticker to open its enterprise profile.
prompts.found_when: A CafeF enterprise page exists and its leadership, ownership, or financial figures can be compared with the company's claims.
prompts.not_found_when: No CafeF enterprise profile matches the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The profile exists but the financial figures are missing or too aggregated to compare.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in the CanCham Vietnam member listings on canchamvietnam.org?
prompts.why_it_matters: A CanCham listing shows a Canadian or international business tie and a reachable chamber contact.

source.name: Canadian Chamber of Commerce in Vietnam (CanCham Vietnam)

prompts.how_to_query: Open the CanCham listings section and scan the member listing pages for the company name.
prompts.found_when: A member listing page names the company.
prompts.not_found_when: No listing on the site matches the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The listings are unreadable or only reachable through an unknown direct link.

prompts.question: Does the company have an employer profile with current job postings on CareerLink Vietnam?
prompts.why_it_matters: Active postings show the company is really hiring and operating at the scale it describes.

source.name: CareerLink Vietnam

prompts.how_to_query: Search CareerLink's employer section for the company's full name to find its company profile page.
prompts.found_when: A company profile page exists, with or without open job postings.
prompts.not_found_when: The employer search returns no profile for that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The employer search is blocked, or the name returns only similarly named companies.

prompts.question: Does the company have a registered employer page and live job ads on CareerViet?
prompts.why_it_matters: A maintained employer page with openings indicates an operating business and shows its hiring footprint by region.

source.name: CareerViet (formerly CareerBuilder Vietnam)

prompts.how_to_query: Use CareerViet's employer search and enter the company's full Vietnamese name.
prompts.found_when: An employer page for the company is returned, with company details or job ads.
prompts.not_found_when: No employer page matches the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search is unavailable or returns only unrelated employers with similar names.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the CCIFV online member directory (annuaire en ligne) on ccifv.org?
prompts.why_it_matters: A CCIFV listing confirms a French or francophone business affiliation and provides a chamber contact route.

source.name: French Chamber of Commerce and Industry in Vietnam (CCIFV)

prompts.how_to_query: Open the CCIFV annuaire en ligne and enter the company name in its search filter.
prompts.found_when: The directory returns a member record for the company.
prompts.not_found_when: The directory search returns no member record for that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory search page errors out or the results are unreadable.

prompts.question: Does the company run a seller storefront with listings on Chợ Tốt, and does its storefront identity match the company's official name?
prompts.why_it_matters: Storefronts show real trading activity but can also be run under names that do not match the registered company.

source.name: Chợ Tốt (Chotot.com)

prompts.how_to_query: Use the Chợ Tốt search box with the company name and review the seller or storefront results.
prompts.found_when: Listings or a seller storefront under the company's name are returned.
prompts.not_found_when: No listing or seller page matches the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Search results are location-gated or the name matches too many private sellers.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in the National Business Registration Portal with an active enterprise code whose registered name, legal representative, and address match the company's own claims?
prompts.why_it_matters: The national register is the authoritative test of whether the entity legally exists and who may sign for it.

source.name: National Business Registration Portal (Cổng thông tin quốc gia về đăng ký doanh nghiệp)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the portal's enterprise name lookup with the company's Vietnamese name and open the registration record.
prompts.found_when: A registration record is returned showing the enterprise code, legal representative, and active status.
prompts.not_found_when: The name lookup returns no enterprise record for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The lookup service is down or the name is too common to isolate one enterprise code.

prompts.question: Is the company listed as a member in the EuroCham Vietnam directory on eurochamvn.org?
prompts.why_it_matters: EuroCham membership indicates a European business link and gives a policy-community contact route.

source.name: European Chamber of Commerce in Vietnam (EuroCham Vietnam)

prompts.how_to_query: Open the EuroCham members page and use its search field with the company name.
prompts.found_when: A member entry for the company is returned.
prompts.not_found_when: The member search returns nothing for that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member search is unavailable or the name matches multiple unrelated members.

prompts.question: Is the company a listed or UPCoM-registered issuer with a security page and disclosures on the Hanoi Stock Exchange (hnx.vn)?
prompts.why_it_matters: Exchange registration means public disclosure duties and verifiable filings on ownership and results.

source.name: Hanoi Stock Exchange (Sở Giao dịch Chứng khoán Hà Nội - HNX)

prompts.how_to_query: Use the HNX listed securities lookup and search by the company's name or ticker.
prompts.found_when: A security detail page for the company exists with filings or disclosures.
prompts.not_found_when: The listed securities lookup returns no security for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The lookup is down or the company is known only by a name that does not map to a ticker.

prompts.question: Does the company have a recruiter page and open hospitality job ads on Hoteljob.vn?
prompts.why_it_matters: Hospitality hiring activity reveals the properties a company actually operates or manages.

source.name: Hoteljob.vn

prompts.how_to_query: Search Hoteljob's recruiter listings by the company's full name to reach its recruiter page.
prompts.found_when: A recruiter page exists, with or without current job ads.
prompts.not_found_when: No recruiter page matches the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The recruiter search is unavailable or the name returns only similar brand names.

prompts.question: Is the company listed as a corporate member of InCham Vietnam on incham.vn?
prompts.why_it_matters: InCham membership confirms an Indian business affiliation and a route to the company through the chamber.

source.name: Indian Chamber of Commerce in Vietnam (InCham)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the InCham corporate member listings on incham.vn for the company name.
prompts.found_when: A corporate member record names the company.
prompts.not_found_when: The member listings contain no record for that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member listing endpoint is unavailable or the name is too generic to match one record.

prompts.question: Does the company have a company page on ITviec with employee reviews or ratings, and what do they say about management and working conditions?
prompts.why_it_matters: Anonymous employee reviews give an unfiltered read on culture and management that marketing pages never show.

source.name: ITviec

prompts.how_to_query: Search ITviec's company directory for the company name and open its company page.
prompts.found_when: A company page exists, with or without reviews.
prompts.not_found_when: The company directory returns no page for that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The company page exists but reviews are locked or the name matches several employers.

prompts.question: Does the company appear on the national e-procurement system (e-GP) as a contractor with bid history, and does it appear on the sanctioned or banned contractor list?
prompts.why_it_matters: Public tender records show whether the company wins state work and whether it has been barred for tender violations.

source.name: National E-Procurement System (Hệ thống mạng đấu thầu quốc gia - e-GP)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the e-GP contractor database and the organisations-violators list with the company's full Vietnamese name.
prompts.found_when: A contractor record with bid or contract history is returned, and any sanctioned entry is noted.
prompts.not_found_when: No contractor record and no sanctioned entry match the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The system requires a login, is unavailable, or the name is too common to isolate one contractor.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in the Nhịp Cầu Đầu Tư Top 50 ranking of listed companies on nhipcaudautu.vn?
prompts.why_it_matters: Placement in this ranking is a third-party credibility signal that can confirm or undercut a company's market claims.

source.name: Nhịp Cầu Đầu Tư Magazine

prompts.how_to_query: Open the Top 50 list page on nhipcaudautu.vn and scan the ranked entries for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the published Top 50 ranking.
prompts.not_found_when: The ranking list contains no entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The ranking page is unreadable, only covers a past year, or the list is not published in full.

prompts.question: Do Otofun forum threads mention the company in connection with service complaints, fraud warnings, or dealer disputes?
prompts.why_it_matters: Forum threads surface customer disputes and fraud alerts that never reach official channels.

source.name: Otofun (Otofun.net)

prompts.how_to_query: Use the forum search with the company name as keywords and sort by relevance.
prompts.found_when: Forum threads naming the company are returned.
prompts.not_found_when: The forum search returns no thread mentioning the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search requires a member login, or the name is too common and returns unrelated chatter.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the SingCham Vietnam company list on singchamvietnam.org?
prompts.why_it_matters: A SingCham listing confirms a Singaporean business affiliation and a chamber contact route.

source.name: Singapore Chamber of Commerce Vietnam (SingCham Vietnam)

prompts.how_to_query: Open the SingCham company list page and scan the member entries for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the member company list.
prompts.not_found_when: No company in the list matches that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The list page is unavailable or the member list is not published in full.

prompts.question: Has the State Securities Commission of Vietnam issued an administrative penalty or disclosure enforcement decision naming the company, or does the company appear as a registered public company on ssc.gov.vn?
prompts.why_it_matters: Securities enforcement actions are official findings of disclosure or trading violations that carry real legal weight.

source.name: State Securities Commission of Vietnam (Ủy ban Chứng khoán Nhà nước - SSC)

prompts.how_to_query: Use the SSC site search with the company's full Vietnamese name and review penalty decisions, prospectus approvals, and public company registrations.
prompts.found_when: A penalty decision, registration record, or prospectus approval naming the company is returned.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no document naming the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search engine returns unrelated documents, or results are only partially readable.

prompts.question: Does the company have a registered wholesale shop profile on Thị Trường Sỉ with matching supplier details and minimum order terms?
prompts.why_it_matters: Wholesale profiles show whether the company really supplies at scale and whether its stated trading identity is consistent.

source.name: Thị Trường Sỉ (Thitruongsi.com)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the marketplace's shop directory for the company's full name.
prompts.found_when: A shop profile matching the company name is returned with supplier contact details.
prompts.not_found_when: No shop profile matches the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The shop directory is unavailable or the name matches only unrelated resellers.

prompts.question: Does the company operate an official or verified storefront on Tiki, and what are its customer ratings and dispute feedback?
prompts.why_it_matters: Marketplace badges and buyer ratings are a fast test of whether a consumer brand is genuine and how it treats customers.

source.name: Tiki

prompts.how_to_query: Search Tiki for the company or brand name and open the resulting store page.
prompts.found_when: A store page under the company or brand name exists, with badges, ratings, or reviews.
prompts.not_found_when: No store page on Tiki matches the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The store page is unreachable or the brand name is used by unrelated sellers.

prompts.question: Is the company listed as a member manufacturer on the VAMA member page (cac-thanh-vien-nsx) at vama.org.vn?
prompts.why_it_matters: VAMA membership confirms an automaker is a recognised assembler or importer and appears in official sales statistics.

source.name: Vietnam Automobile Manufacturers Association (VAMA)

prompts.how_to_query: Open the VAMA member manufacturers page and scan the member list for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the VAMA member manufacturers list.
prompts.not_found_when: The member list contains no entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member page is unreadable or the site is unreachable.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in the VASEP member directory with a seafood processor profile and export approval codes?
prompts.why_it_matters: A VASEP member profile with approval codes shows the company is a recognised seafood exporter cleared for key markets.

source.name: Vietnam Association of Seafood Exporters and Producers (VASEP)

prompts.how_to_query: Open VASEP's member information section and scan member profiles for the company name, or search the site for it.
prompts.found_when: A VASEP member profile page for the company exists.
prompts.not_found_when: No member profile matches the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member directory is unreachable or the name matches several similarly named processors.

prompts.question: Does the company post job ads as an employer on Việc Làm Tốt, and do the postings match the operating locations the company claims?
prompts.why_it_matters: Mass-market hiring ads reveal warehouse, factory, or retail operations the company may not advertise elsewhere.

source.name: Việc Làm Tốt (formerly Chợ Tốt Việc Làm)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the job listings on vieclamtot.com by the company's full name.
prompts.found_when: Job ads from the company are returned.
prompts.not_found_when: No job ad names the company.

prompts.question: Does the company have a company profile with executive or mid-senior job postings on VietnamWorks?
prompts.why_it_matters: Senior hiring activity and office locations show whether the company operates at the scale and level it presents.

source.name: VietnamWorks

prompts.how_to_query: Search VietnamWorks company profiles for the company's full name.
prompts.found_when: A company profile page exists, with or without current postings.
prompts.not_found_when: The company profile search returns no match.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The company search endpoint is unavailable or the name matches several employers.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in VIETRADE's verified export enterprise directory, and does it appear among Vietnam Value national brand winners?
prompts.why_it_matters: Government trade-promotion listings and national brand awards corroborate export claims and market standing.

source.name: Vietnam Trade Promotion Agency (Cục Xúc tiến Thương mại - VIETRADE)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the VIETRADE enterprise directory and the Vietnam Value award lists with the company's full Vietnamese name.
prompts.found_when: A verified enterprise entry or an award listing names the company.
prompts.not_found_when: Neither the enterprise directory nor the award lists contain the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory is unavailable or the name is too generic to confirm the exact entity.

prompts.question: Does the company have a Vietstock Finance page whose balance sheet, charter capital, ownership structure, and dividend history match the figures the company presents?

prompts.found_when: A Vietstock company page exists with financials or ownership data to compare.
prompts.not_found_when: No Vietstock page matches the company name.

prompts.not_found_when: Neither the member lists nor the award lists contain the company name.

prompts.how_to_query: Open the VLA member directory and enter the company's full name in its keyword search field.
prompts.found_when: A member directory entry names the company.

prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory search is unavailable or the name returns only similar trading names.
